title: Recap: scalar adverbs, and adverbs of speed and permanence

sections.title: What you know
sections.content: You know scalar adverbs such as *számottevően* and *drasztikusan* from C1 Unit 19. This lesson adds adverbs for the speed and the permanence of a loss: *vészesen* ('alarmingly'), *fokozatosan* ('gradually'), *szemlátomást* ('visibly, before one's eyes') and *visszafordíthatatlanul* ('irreversibly').

sections.title: Position
sections.content: They stand before the verb: *a talajvíz vészesen csökken*. *Drámai ütemben* ('at a dramatic pace') is a phrase with the same job.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A talajvízkészlet vészesen csökken a forró nyári hónapokban.
The groundwater reserve is decreasing alarmingly during the hot summer months.
Az őshonos erdők területe fokozatosan zsugorodik az Alföldön.
The area of the native forests is shrinking gradually on the Great Plain.
A kutak vize szemlátomást csökkent a száraz nyáron.
The water in the wells visibly fell in the dry summer.
